title: E.l.f. breaks into fragrance and body care with ‘sensorial’ own-brand e.l.f. POP
summary: The parent company of e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. Skin and e.l.f. Hair is expanding its beauty empire with e.l.f. POP – an own-brand fragrance and body care line inspired by holiday destinations – following the success of its perfume collaboration with H&M
